source.note: Every timestamp visible in these captures is server-rendered from the fixture rows, so it is fixed by the seed, not by the capture run. Nothing was clicked: GET navigation only.

truthInvariants.bookingConfirmed: false on all 9 seeded call summaries
truthInvariants.appointmentOutcome: NULL on all 9 seeded call summaries
truthInvariants.addressFields: none seeded and none exist in DRAFT_DATA_COLLECTION
truthInvariants.timeWindowFields: none seeded and none exist in DRAFT_DATA_COLLECTION
truthInvariants.verifiedBy: scripts/film-verify.mjs plus the per-shot mustNotContain guards below

captureConditions.colorScheme: dark (as shipped; globals.css sets --nv-bg #02080d and color-scheme: dark)
captureConditions.reducedMotion: reduce — the portal sky paints one fixed pose via its own code path (public/motion/aurora.js)
captureConditions.injectedCssRationale: Identical in effect to globals.css's own prefers-reduced-motion rule. No colour, component or layout rule was added, removed or overridden.
captureConditions.stickyHeader: The portal header is sticky top-0 z-20. Each shot scrolls so the target clears it; the measured clearance is recorded per capture.
captureConditions.viewportGrowth: Where a target exceeded the stated viewport height, the height alone was grown (width and deviceScaleFactor unchanged, so layout is identical) and the page reloaded. statedViewport and effectiveViewport are both recorded.
captureConditions.browserClock: fixed at 2026-08-10T18:00:00Z (browser-side only; all visible times are server-rendered)

captures.name: c07b-refusal
captures.what: The refusal fieldset, whole and exactly as it ships. The product stating, on the client's own settings page, what it does not do and cannot be made to do. NOTE: the fieldset's lower half is the CASL identification block, whose empty Mailing address box shows the shipped PLACEHOLDER "123 Example Ave NW, Edmonton, AB T5A 0A1". Nothing is stored there (mailingAddress is NULL) and it is the CLIENT's own address field, not a caller's — but it is address-shaped text on screen. Use c07b-refusal-statement if the film needs the claim with no address in frame.
selectors: fieldset:has-text("Confirmation texts to your customers are not available yet")
captures.text:
CONFIRMATION TEXTS TO YOUR CUSTOMERS ARE NOT AVAILABLE YET
NOT AGREED

We do not text your customers, and no account can turn this on today. Your assistant does not book jobs, and it never asks a caller for permission to text them. So there is nothing to confirm and nobody who has agreed to be messaged. You are told about every call instead — by text and by email, within seconds.

If it is ever switched on, Canadian law treats you as the sender of that message, not us. So it would have to carry your legal business name and a way to reach you, and anyone could stop it by replying STOP. Those two details are collected here now so that nothing has to be rushed later; filling them in sends nothing.

Record my agreement in advance, for if this is ever offered. Nothing is sent today.
LEGAL BUSINESS NAME
The name you actually carry on business under, as it appears on your registration.
MAILING ADDRESS
Required by law to be reachable from the message. It is not shown in the text itself — it lives on a page the text links to.
